title: Oracle Midday Brief
script_summary:
Bitcoin surges past seventy-seven thousand four hundred six dollars, up six point three percent in twenty-four hours, with fear and greed hitting seventy-two in greed territory. US morning session shows steady buying pressure lifting the price without major resistance.
